follow-up time: From diagnosis of low-lying placenta or placenta previa between 17-24 weeks gestation to at or after 36 weeks 0 days
exposure: history of intrauterine curettage or evacuation
cohort: 705 pregnant women diagnosed with low-lying placenta or placenta previa between 17 and 24 weeks gestation at a single institution between 2003 and 2017
finding: Women with a prior cesarean delivery or a history of intrauterine curettage or evacuation in the setting of placenta previa were more likely to have persistent placenta previa.
mod_finding: Women with a prior cesarean delivery were seven times more likely to have persistent placenta previa.
